tests.command: go=$(for f in $A2DLC_TESTS; do case $f in *_test.go) echo ./$(dirname $f);; esac; done | sort -u); py=$(for f in $A2DLC_TESTS; do case $f in engines/py/test_*.py) echo $f;; esac; done); rc=0; if [ -n "$go" ]; then gotestsum --format dots --junitfile /tmp/go.xml -- -count=1 -coverpkg=./... -coverprofile=/tmp/c.out $go || rc=1; fi; if [ -n "$py" ]; then HOME=/tmp python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider --rootdir=. -o junit_family=xunit1 --junitxml=/tmp/py.xml $py || rc=1; fi; python -c 'import sys,os,xml.etree.ElementTree as E; r=E.Element("testsuites"); [r.extend(t if t.tag=="testsuites" else [t]) for t in (E.parse(q).getroot() for q in sys.argv[2:] if os.path.exists(q) and os.path.getsize(q))]; E.ElementTree(r).write(sys.argv[1])' "$A2DLC_JUNIT" /tmp/go.xml /tmp/py.xml; [ -s /tmp/c.out ] || echo 'mode: set' > /tmp/c.out; gocover-cobertura < /tmp/c.out > "$A2DLC_COVERAGE"; exit $rc
tests.baseline_command: go=$(for f in $A2DLC_CHANGED $A2DLC_TESTS; do case $f in *.go) echo ./$(dirname $f);; esac; done | sort -u); py=$(for f in $A2DLC_CHANGED $A2DLC_TESTS; do case $f in engines/py/*.py) echo y;; esac; done | head -1); [ -n "$py" ] && py=$(ls engines/py/test_*.py); [ -n "$go$py" ] || go=./cmd/a2dlc; rc=0; if [ -n "$go" ]; then gotestsum --format dots --junitfile /tmp/go.xml -- -count=1 -coverpkg=./... -coverprofile=/tmp/c.out $go || rc=1; fi; if [ -n "$py" ]; then HOME=/tmp python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider --rootdir=. -o junit_family=xunit1 --junitxml=/tmp/py.xml $py || rc=1; fi; python -c 'import sys,os,xml.etree.ElementTree as E; r=E.Element("testsuites"); [r.extend(t if t.tag=="testsuites" else [t]) for t in (E.parse(q).getroot() for q in sys.argv[2:] if os.path.exists(q) and os.path.getsize(q))]; E.ElementTree(r).write(sys.argv[1])' "$A2DLC_JUNIT" /tmp/go.xml /tmp/py.xml; [ -s /tmp/c.out ] || echo 'mode: set' > /tmp/c.out; gocover-cobertura < /tmp/c.out > "$A2DLC_COVERAGE"; exit $rc
